source.section: Schedule SB (PDF page 1) and its Instructions: line 16 and its Caution (SB Instructions PDF page 7; Publication 126 PDF page 8 section 4.E(1); Publication 106 PDF page 4 section 3.C(1)); line 17 and the Retirement Income Subtraction Worksheet lines 1-6 (SB Instructions PDF page 8; Publication 126 PDF pages 8-9 section 4.E(2)); Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7

worked: Single, born 1959-01-02: 66 on December 31, 2025, so no line 16 subtraction; federal AGI 50,000 is over 15,000, so no line 17 either. The IRA is taxed in full; line 10b allows 250 (65 or older). Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 30,000.00 + ira distribution (you) 20,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 = 32,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 50,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 50,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 50,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Schedule SB line 17: federal AGI 50,000.00 is not less than 15,000.00, so no 5,000 subtraction. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 50,000.00 - 0.00 = 50,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 50,000 to less than 50,500, column Single: 9,876.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 50,000 / 50,500 / 9,876 / 20,751 / 4,640 / 10,608). Line 9 = 50,000.00 - 9,876.00 = 40,124.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 1 x 250 = 250.00; line 10c 950.00. Line 11 taxable income = 40,124.00 - 950.00 = 39,174.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 24,494.00 = 1,077.736; total 1,591.536, rounded once to 1,591.54. The Tax Table row 39,100 to 39,200 (PDF page 40) gives 1,590; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,591.54.
